reviews.text: Lucas always gets his baths and grooming here. The service is excellent, and the groomers are very professional. They always make Lucas look adorable.

I had such a great experience here! The staff was friendly, professional, and took such good care of my dog. They were very gentle and made sure she was comfortable throughout the grooming process. She came home looking and smelling amazing, and I could tell they really took their time with her.

It’s always a little nerve-racking leaving your pet with someone, but I felt completely comfortable knowing she was in good hands. I’m so happy with how her grooming turned out and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

I absolutely love bringing my puppies here! 🐶❤️ Their hair always comes out looking beautiful, fresh, and exactly how I requested. The groomers are so patient, caring, and attentive, and they always make sure I’m satisfied with the results. I truly appreciate the love and care they give my puppies every time. I highly recommend them 100%! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The lady was very thoughtful; she washed my hair until it was very fluffy.

I took my scottish fold here for the full package cleaning. I was soooo happy with how it all turned out. My cat is a bit anxious (so am I lol) but the staff was so wonderful. They even sent a video during  the middle of the visit to show us the progress. I will be coming back here again and recommended this place to others who have cats.
Excellent service
My baby got a very cute haircut here🥰 …
nice hair cut for my cats
I've always had good service from them.

Great experience from start to finish! They did an amazing job with my pet and paid attention to all the little details. The staff was kind and professional, and the whole process was easy. Very happy with the result!

Such a nice experience! The place was clean and welcoming, and they were very gentle and attentive with my pet. I really appreciated how much care they put into everything. My pet came home looking fresh and adorable. Highly recommend!

I have to give this shop a huge thumbs up! My cat is usually very timid and easily stressed when we go out. But the staff at this shop were incredibly gentle and professional, handling my cat gently and constantly calming her down, treating her like their own child. The entire grooming process went very smoothly; it's clear they genuinely love animals. My cat was in great spirits after we brought her home, not unhappy at all. I'm so lucky to have found such a trustworthy pet shop. Five stars!
The groomers are very nice and patient with my puppy. I’m really grateful with the styling. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a place for your pet. All services were professional, amazing job!
My dog, Duoduo, has always loved getting his hair done by this beautiful female groomer. As a loyal dog lover, he told me I absolutely had to give him five stars. Thanks!

I brought my Morkie here for grooming and had a great experience! The groomer was very gentle and patient with her, and her haircut came out so cute. They did a great job with the trim and paid attention to the little details.

My dog looked so clean, fluffy, and adorable when I picked her up! I’m really happy with the result and will definitely be coming back for her next grooming. Highly recommend! 🐶💕
Absolutely THE best place to bring your pet, now he doesn’t feel hot anymore!
Amazing grooming! Very happy with the results and will definitely continue using their service. Highly recommended!
A place I'll be coming to often from now on

Great location and the staff who takes care of my dog is so sweet and also they are very professional at what they are doing highly recommended this place with anyone who has pet I am always satisfied with their service every time I come here with my dog

Our dog is extremely afraid of baths and haircuts, and many salons wouldn't take him. Today we went to this salon, and the owner was super professional, the staff were incredibly patient with the haircut and bath, and the results were amazing! Highly recommended!!
My dog always leaves here super cute and they keep me in the loop about him through his grooming appointment!

This is a highly recommended pet grooming shop. Coco has been getting her groomed here for six months now and is always very satisfied. The staff are attentive, responsible, and very patient, and the prices are very reasonable! Coco always looks adorable here. Highly recommended!!
The owner is very attentive to understanding the needs of the pets, and the groomers are also very loving and dedicated in serving them.

Great Grooming Experience

I’m so happy with the grooming service! My cat looks absolutely adorable and smells so fresh and clean. 💕 The staff were very friendly, gentle, and took great care of my dog. You can really tell that they love what they do.

The grooming was beautifully done, and my dog came home happy and comfortable. I’ll definitely be coming back again. Highly recommend this place! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
This adorable and well-behaved pet kindergarten made me feel welcome from the moment I walked in. Leaving my furry friend here felt so reassuring, like having a second home.

The best grooming place for dog and cat. Loved it every time my baby girl went.
My girl dog only 3.5 lb, and she is 5 years old I always try to focus on her emotions after her grooming more than anything else. But this place cuts cute hair for her , and takes good care of my dog too.
The haircut was excellent, and the ears were cleaned very thoroughly.

This is the second time my cats have been to a groomer and I was really careful in looking for one. The last place they went in Brooklyn accidentally hurt my rag dolls shoulder so since I moved to flushing I looked through all the groomers in my area. Specifically ones that work with many cats. After extensive research and options I found furry babies with good reviews. My ragdoll has been vomiting a lot of furballs lately so I wanted to get him a lion cut and my ginger boy was greasy with dirty ears and chin. Both came out beautifully, I’m so happy I found this place. Reasonable prices too. My ginger boy doesn’t allow me to clean his ears and I thought his chin was acne but this place cleared out all the gunk and he’s good as new! Highly recommend, so happy I found this place. I’ll def come back.
The service was excellent; they were very patient and listened to me ramble on for ages, haha, MoMo.

A friend recommended this place, and I specifically came all the way from New Jersey to Flushing for my dog's grooming 🫶

The consultation during drop-off was very clear, and the staff were incredibly kind and genuinely love dogs. They cut the hair exactly as we discussed. I got a summer cut, and the little ball of fluff on the tail is absolutely adorable 🥺 It's definitely thanks to the skill of a Chinese barber! I can finally leave the salon happy 🫰

The prices are reasonable, and they differentiate based on weight. There's CCTV surveillance in the grooming area, which you can also watch from outside, so I felt very safe. My dog ​​came out happy too.
The staff were very patient and gentle with the dogs. My dog ​​smelled wonderful and had fluffy fur after his bath in March—I'm extremely satisfied! I'll definitely come back!
The service was excellent, and the beautician's skills were superb. She made my little one's haircut look absolutely adorable! 🥰
Great customer service and a lovely atmosphere inside."👍 …
The staff is very friendly and doesn't make you feel awkward at all. My cats and dogs all get their grooming done here; they're very attentive. I recommend them to everyone.
The only grooming spot I trust. Staff are friendly and welcoming. Service is great.
This pet grooming salon did a fantastic job grooming my pet! I'm extremely satisfied!
They were very patient and friendly, taking photos of each step and showing them to me. They were fantastic!
Amazing experience! The staff were patient and helpful, the store was clean, and they had a great selection of pets. Highly recommend this store! The staff were very patient and attentive. Go for it!

Very good experience at Furry Babies! My kitty always scared to take shower at pet store except Furry babies. They have good equipment for cat, the technicians are precessional and always take good care of my cat’s emotions. Highly recommend the Furry babies👍👍👍

My black cat, Emo, is quite timid, and I was worried he'd be stressed, but the staff were very patient and reassuring. The grooming was thorough, leaving his fur clean and fluffy, and Emo was in great spirits after coming home. Overall, a fantastic experience, highly recommended!
A very good pet store. My Alaskan Malamute loves coming here the most; he's always happy when we come.
Excellent service 👍 …
Our cat comes here for grooming regularly. The groomer and receptionist are both very friendly, and we are very satisfied. 👍 …
I recently go to Furry Babies for my cat shower and cut hair. Their service was perfect and professional. All of the workers are friendly. Will come back again!!
This is my go-to pet store. The service is excellent, and the prices are reasonable. It's the best pet store I've seen in New York.
I highly recommend this pet grooming shop. My dog always has a great time here and gets so excited every time we visit. The staff are friendly, caring, and do an amazing job!

I'm so happy! I feel like I've restored my darlings' good looks! They're so clean and smell wonderful, it feels like their mood has been washed away too. They're so clean they can go to bed right now! ♡ Thank you to this shop for existing, and thank you to all the patient, loving, responsible, and professional staff who treat pets so well.

This has been my go-to grooming shop for my dog’s baths, and they never disappoint! Yesterday I brought my pup in for a nail trim, anal gland expression, and ear cleaning — the service was quick and excellent. The staff are so gentle and caring with my dog, which really puts me at ease. Highly recommend to all dog owners looking for a reliable, trustworthy groomer!
A fantastic and well-connected shop! Highly recommended! 👍

I took our British shorthair cat over this past weekend. The staff were courteous, professional, and caring. Zero complaints or whatsoever. What most impressed me was their honesty. I accidently put in an extra $100 bill in the payment, and left. One of the staff members, a young gentleman, soon realized it. He ran across the street and put the extra money back in my hand. Only someone with impeccable professionalism and integrity would do that! Thank you, Furry Babies Grooming!

I recently took my cat to furry babies, and I can confidently say it is the best pet grooming service in the Queens! From the moment we walked in, the staff was welcoming and professional.

The grooming area is clean and well-organized, which immediately put me at ease. My cat, who can be quite picky, absolutely loved it here! The groomers took the time to get to know her and made sure she was comfortable throughout the entire process.

The results were fantastic! My cat came out looking and feeling amazing. The attention to detail and care provided by the team truly sets this place apart. I highly recommend to any pet owner looking for a top-notch grooming experience. We will definitely be returning!
